newsitem.title: USA: AMEX to list Newport News options Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: AMEX to list Newport News options Tuesday.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange (AMEX) said Monday it would list options on Newport News Shipbuilding Inc on Tuesday, December 17.
The exchange said the options would have opening strike prices of 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2 and initial expirations in January, February, May and August.
Shares of the company were down 5/8 at 15-7/8 around midday Monday.
Kalb, Voorhis & Co/Harvey, Young, Yurman will be the specialist for the options, the AMEX said. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
